name: Can hardware and functional adjustments improve energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can hardware and functional adjustments improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proper hardware and functional adjustments can contribute to improved energy efficiency. For example, ensuring windows and doors close and seal tightly prevents drafts and reduces heat loss or gain. Adjusting weatherstripping and door sweeps to create a complete seal is crucial. A well-adjusted window or door will minimize air infiltration, which can lower heating and cooling costs. This practical tradeoff highlights how small adjustments yield larger benefits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly adjusted windows and doors, with tight seals, can prevent drafts and reduce air infiltration, contributing to better energy efficiency.
